finding.title: SQL Injection in user query handler
finding.message: User input is concatenated into SQL query without parameterisation.
finding.description: String concatenation used to build SQL query with user-supplied input.

location.snippet: query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + user_id

triage.reasoning: User input flows directly into SQL query. Public-facing endpoint.
triage.exploitability_notes: Directly exploitable via HTTP request parameter.

remediation.title: Use parameterised queries in user query handler
remediation.business_impact: Attacker can read, modify, or delete any data in the database.
steps: Replace string concatenation with parameterised query.
Use cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', (user_id,)).
Add input validation for user_id parameter.

finding.title: Reflected XSS in search endpoint
finding.message: User input is reflected in HTML response without escaping.
finding.description: Search query parameter is rendered directly in the HTML page.

triage.reasoning: Direct reflection of user input in HTML without sanitisation.
triage.exploitability_notes: Exploitable via crafted URL. Requires user interaction.

remediation.title: Escape user input in search results page
remediation.business_impact: Attacker can execute JavaScript in victim's browser, steal sessions.
steps: Import html.escape from the standard library.
Consider using a template engine with auto-escaping.
remediation.code_snippet:
from html import escape return f"

Results for {escape(query)}

"

finding.title: Prototype pollution in lodash < 4.17.21
finding.message: lodash versions before 4.17.21 are vulnerable to prototype pollution.
finding.description: Prototype pollution vulnerability in lodash merge/defaults functions.

triage.reasoning: Known CVE but exploitation requires specific usage of merge/defaults.
triage.exploitability_notes: Depends on how lodash is used. Check for merge with user input.

remediation.title: Upgrade lodash to 4.17.21
remediation.business_impact: Potential remote code execution if attacker controls merge input.
steps: Verify no breaking changes in lodash changelog.

finding.title: Unused import detected
finding.message: Module 'os' is imported but not used.
finding.description: Static analysis detected an unused import statement.

triage.reasoning: Unused import is a code quality issue, not a security vulnerability.

finding.title: Hardcoded API key in configuration
finding.message: API key is hardcoded in source file.
finding.description: A secret value appears to be hardcoded in the source code.

triage.reasoning: Hardcoded secret in source code. If repo is public, key is compromised.
triage.exploitability_notes: Immediately exploitable if repository is public or shared.

remediation.title: Move API key to environment variable
remediation.business_impact: Leaked credentials allow unauthorised access to external service.
steps: Remove the hardcoded key from source code.
Use os.environ.get('API_KEY') to read from environment.
Add API_KEY to .env.example with a placeholder value.
